<thought>The spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope with peaks spaced ~1.003 Da apart and decreasing intensities (≈9 % for M+1, ≈0.6 % for M+2, etc.). This pattern matches the natural 13C distribution in organic molecules and does not display the ~2 Da spacing or characteristic intensity ratios of Cl, Br, S, etc. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
